changes: FIX-01 [Factual Error — S13 JMR 2019]: In theme.chapters[3].new_information, sources[X154R1-S13] (reading_scope, summary, locator), and K154-0111 (answer_target, editorial.visual, source_locator), heavy rain (>7.6 mm/h, 9 events) is wrongly stated to reach a maximum scavenging ratio of 83.9% (or '70.9% 至 83.9%'), and 'Table 2' is cited. Correct heavy rain max to 70.9% (or explicitly state moderate rain reached up to 83.9% and heavy rain up to 70.9%) and change 'Table 2' to 'Table 1'.

FIX-02 [Over-Attribution & Bad Locator — S03 PMC9234473]: In theme.evidence_gaps, theme.chapters[3].new_information, sources[X154R1-S03], K154-0103, and K154-0111, S03's '−87%' (PM2.5) and '−81%' (PM10) are attributed purely to May–Oct rainy-season wet deposition and cited to nonexistent 'Section 3.3'. Per S03 Section 3.1.1, −87% and −81% are 2020 vs. 2018–2019 percentage changes during the rainy season 'in conjunction with the COVID-19 restrictions' (not pure dry-vs-wet rainfall scavenging). Also fix Section 3.2 attributions: 80% (2018–2019) and 78% (2020) are central+southern shares of annual nonattainment days, and PM2.5 accounted for 51% (2018–2019) and 31% (2020) of total nonattainment days (remove '約六成不良日由 PM2.5 主導'). Update locators from 'Section 3.3' to 'Sections 3.1.1 & 3.2'.

FIX-03 [Scope & Data Mischaracterization — S14 PMC8247015]: (a) In theme.chapters[3], sources[X154R1-S14], and K154-0112, clarify that the 183.8 µg/m³ baking increment occurred in a WORKPLACE bakery (without home indoor/outdoor sensors, Sec. 3.3), not a home family kitchen; (b) In theme.chapters[5], sources[X154R1-S14], and K154-0118, remove the incorrect label '無室內污染源時' / '無源時室內中位數' for 6.2 / 8.8 / 9.6 µg/m³ — S14 Table 1B reports these as all-period indoor PERSONAL PM2.5 exposure medians across the entire non-raining period (including source events up to 196.5–207.6 µg/m³), and add 'Table 1' to S14's locator; (c) In sources[X154R1-S14].summary, change '每分鐘 93.3 μg/m³ 增幅' to '1 分鐘峰值增幅 93.3 μg/m³'.

FIX-04 [Meteorological Mechanism & Locator Errors — S01 & S05]: (a) In theme.connection, separate northeasterly monsoon lee-side stagnation (S03) from southeasterly/east-southeasterly lee vortices (S01 explicitly excludes strong NE monsoon days in Sec. 2b & 3a); (b) In sources[X154R1-S01].summary and K154-0101 (editorial.visual & source_locator), change '8 站以上' to exact '8 站' (S01 Sec. 3b: 'eight stations with values above 0.8'); (c) In K154-0102.answer_target, remove '傍晚撞上逆溫鍋蓋' from the 2017-03-10 Lunbei (119) → Puli (127) event — S05 Sec. 4.2 explicitly classifies it as an external-source valley-transport event NOT modeled by local temperature inversion, peaking at 20:00–21:00 (night); update S05 & K154-0102 locators to include Sections 3.2 and 4.2 (Table 5).

FIX-05 [Secondary-Citation Misattribution & Missing Caveats — S15 & S09]: (a) In theme.chapters[3], theme.chapters[5], sources[X154R1-S15], K154-0112, and K154-0117, stop attributing '煎炸產生的微粒是水煮的 6 到 10 倍' to LBNL's experiment — S15 Sec. 3.1 cites Wallace et al. changes: FIX-01 [Scientific Accuracy — S18 EC50]: In `theme.chapters[4].new_information`, replace `海膽胚胎半致死濃度 EC50` with `海膽胚胎半數效應濃度 EC50（抑制幼體生長 50% 之濃度）` — per PMC8588384 Section 2.3 & Table 3, EC50 measures 50% larval growth inhibition, NOT lethality (LC50). Also clarify that 2,403.8 mg/L is for 98–99% hydrolyzed pure PVA (PVA.031), while 87–89% hydrolyzed PVA with 15% glycerol (PVA.029) had EC50 = 4,285 mg/L (TU = 2.3, slight toxicity on TU scale but still harmless under EU CLP >100 mg/L).

FIX-02 [Scientific Precision — S12 Assay Endpoint]: In `theme.chapters[2].new_information`, `sources[X154R4-S12].summary`, and `candidates[K154-0408].answer_target` & `editorial.visual`, replace `蛋白移除率／清除率` (`94.2%`, `70.6%`, `35.0%`) with `蛋白質溶解回收率（可被一般鹼性介面活性劑溶解帶走的比率）`. Per PMC11415368 Results & Discussion, 1% SDS (pH 11.0) lifted cracked blood off stainless plates at 95 °C but could not solubilize the thermally coagulated disulfide-bonded precipitate in solution.

FIX-03 [Undisclosed Industry COI & Correction — S08, S07, S06]: (a) In `X154R4-S08`, update `network` and `limitations` to disclose that 2 of 3 authors (1st & co-corresponding) are employees of Lubrizol Life Science, that it is a secondary review article, and that it has a 2025 correction notice (`Antibiotics 2025;14(3):292`); do not attribute its cited secondary numbers solely to `英國曼徹斯特都會大學`. (b) In `X154R4-S07.limitations`, disclose that co-author Mirko Weide is affiliated with Henkel AG & Co. KGaA (paper notes no corporate role in study design/analysis/writing). (c) In `X154R4-S06.limitations`, change `部分作者` to `主要作者群（8 位中有 7 位，含第一與通訊作者）隸屬日本日用品企業研究單位` (keeping commercial company names out of viewer-facing copy).

FIX-04 [Locator & Scope Corrections — S01, S02, S04, S05, S07, S08, S12, S13, S16, S17]: Fix wrong/nonexistent locators: `S05` `pp. 1–6` -> `pp. 3, 5–7, 11–13, 15` (and note p. 11 oversudsing/pump-overheat Q&A specifically addresses using regular non-HE detergent in HE washers); `S07` `Figure 2` -> `Figure 1` (no Fig. 2 exists); `S08` `Sections 2–4` -> `Sections 2, 3, 6` (Fabric Malodour is Section 6); `S13` `Section 3` -> `Sections 1–2` (and disclose in `S13.summary` that fabric softener *increased* cotton towel bacterial removal from 81.3% to 94.9% while reducing microfiber from 89.8% to 72.0%); `S17` `Tables 1–3` -> `Tables 1–2 & Figure 2` (`Table S1–S3` are Supplementary); tighten paraphrased section headings in `S01` (`1 Engage` Steps 1–3 & `4 Explain` Step 7), `S02` (`Physical Properties of Carboxylate Salts` & `Example 15.5.2`), `S04` (`Sections 1.2, 2.2, 2.3.1, 2.3.7, 2.5.1`), `S12` (`Introduction`, `Results Fig. 1` & `Discussion`), and `S16` (`Section B.4 Comparability of Test Results` & `16 CFR §1615.4(g)(4)/§1616.5(c)(4)`).

FIX-05 [Concentration & Regulatory Scope Precision — S14, S16, S19, S23]: (a) In Ch. 4 & `K154-0410`, explicitly tag `10 g/L` for S14 cationic softener wetting time (`8.1 -> 15.5 s`) and bottom spreading speed (`1.69 -> 0.45 mm/s`) versus `20 g/L` for bottom absorption rate (`45.17 -> 27.2%/s`) so viewers are not misled into thinking all three came from 20 g/L. (b) In Ch. 4 & `K154-0412`, change `美國市售柔軟精皆須標示／皆須印製警語` to `皆載明` (65 FR 12924 describes existing softener package labels rather than mandating them). (c) In Ch. 5, `S19.summary`, & `K154-0413`, accurately separate the denied TSCA Sec. 21 testing petition from the denied APA petition requesting SCIL status change from `green circle` to `gray square`. (d) In Ch. 5, `S23.summary`, & `K154-0415`, reword `2 起高齡者誤吞後死於化學性肺炎` to `2 起高齡者誤吞身亡（其中記載個案死於化學性肺炎）` since p. 4 details chemical pneumonia for Case 7 but not the second PIO-NET fatality.
